activity_statements.statement: issues credit and charge cards to consumers, small businesses, mid-sized companies, and large corporations in the US and internationally
acquires merchants and processes card transactions at approximately 108 million merchant locations worldwide, earning discount-rate revenue
operates a global card payment network through which it licenses the American Express brand and extends network reach to third-party banks in approximately 120 countries
provides fraud prevention, point-of-sale marketing, and data analytics services to merchants participating in its network
designs and operates customer loyalty programs and co-branded cards for partners including airline and hotel brands
offers travel and lifestyle services, corporate card expense management, and B2B payment products to business customers
operates Resy dining reservation platform and Business Blueprint digital cash-flow management hub for small businesses
generates revenue through a spend-centric model, earning primarily discount revenue on card spending ($1,551B worldwide billed business in 2024) and secondarily net interest income on lending

name_reality_gap: Reads as a credit card company; in reality it operates a vertically integrated payments ecosystem — simultaneously the card issuer, the merchant acquirer, and the global network — distinguishing it structurally from Visa/Mastercard (networks only) or pure-play banks (issuers only).
extraction_notes: Direct website (americanexpress.com) timed out; profile built from SEC 2024 Annual Report and investor relations press release. Segment revenue weights are approximate directional estimates, not exact reported figures.
